name: agent-bus
description: A message bus between agent sessions: mail is served between tool calls, a Monitor wakes an idle agent, urgent mail can be typed into Orca terminals, a /bus chat pane, an unread band and a localhost web chat show it all. Built on orca-bus.

busDir.title: Bus directory
busDir.description: Where the bus keeps its inboxes, registry and log. Relative paths are under the project root (the nearest folder with .git or .claude).

role.title: Default role
role.description: This session's role when neither AGENT_BUS_ROLE nor ORCA_BUS_NAME is set and the terminal is not registered. Usually left empty: the coordinator sets AGENT_BUS_ROLE when it starts a worker.

roles.title: Roles created by init
roles.description: Comma-separated roles `bus.py init` registers in file mode.

orcaBusPath.title: orca-bus checkout
orcaBusPath.description: A local checkout of orca-bus to import from. Empty: use the installed package (pip install "git+https://github.com/polygon-mv/orca-bus").

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python interpreter that runs the bus (3.9 or newer).

backend.title: Terminal backend for urgent mail
backend.description: orca: the deliver daemon may type urgent mail and idle nudges into Orca terminals. none: nothing is ever typed; mail arrives through the hook and the Monitor only.

nudgeAfter.title: Nudge after (seconds)
nudgeAfter.description: orca backend: seconds of unread mail before the daemon types one nudge into an idle tab. Never sent while that role has a live watch.

monitor.title: Ask the agent to arm a Monitor
monitor.description: on: at session start, and once before going idle, a session with a role and no live watch is told to arm a Monitor on `bus.py watch`. off: never.

chatPort.title: Web chat port
chatPort.description: Port of the localhost web chat (`bus.py chat`).

chatBind.title: Web chat bind address
chatBind.description: The chat binds to loopback only: 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1.

tasksDb.title: Task tracker database
tasksDb.description: Optional: a task-tracker SQLite db whose in-progress tasks the chat shows per role.

taskPrefix.title: Task id prefix
taskPrefix.description: The task tracker's id prefix (PREFIX-123); such ids become task chips in the chat and the TUI.

band.title: Unread band above the prompt
band.description: on: while the /bus pane is closed and the user has unread mail or @mentions, a one-line band above the prompt shows the counts with an Open button. off: never.

theme.title: Chat pane theme
theme.description: Colors of the /bus pane and band: tokyonight (blue accent) or claude (orange accent).
